title: Item:Isle of Dread Treasure Map

{{Nonconsumable | name = Isle of Dread Treasure Map | picdesc = Isle of Dread Treasure Map.png | acquired = [[Zalnathe]] | location = [[The Harbor]] and Eberron [[Hall of Heroes]] | minlevel = 1 | bind = {{Bind|BtA|BoA}} | effect = Clicky: {{Clicky|Expanded Teleport|7|no|N/A}} | cost = 300 pp | weight = 0.01 lbs | description = This treasure map can direct you to the Isle of Dread.

This item is capable of Teleporting you to a variety of locations depending on what you've unlocked.

This item has a one-minute cooldown to re-roll into its case. | notes = ** Ownership of this item unlocks the [[Village of Tanaroa]] destination for Expanded Teleport. ** As of [[Update 80]], the cooldown is 20 seconds, but {{bug|this is not reflected in the description|term=}}. }}
